title: Any gamedev channel dedicated 100% to AI workflows?
author: FutureLynx_

comments.author: forcegames
comments.body:
We have an AI GameDev community with over 316 members right now. We’d love to have you join us if you're interested!

[https://www.skool.com/ai-gamedev-lab/about](https://www.skool.com/ai-gamedev-lab/about)

replies.author: MTOMalley
replies.body: 30 bucks a month to get what exactly? Discord access?

replies.author: forcegames
replies.body: There are quite a few modules and documents inside and it’s not just like Discord access. So, would you join if it were $7 or $17?

replies.author: Subject-Yam2179
replies.body: You're better off in the OpenClaw Dischord. I seldom openclaw and it's the best dischord chat I've ever been in. General AI chat, free, great chats

replies.author: forcegames
replies.body:
I've real experince but of course, decision is yours.

[https://www.forbes.com/profile/gokhan-kinay/](https://www.forbes.com/profile/gokhan-kinay/)

I just wanted to say that we have a community focused on game dev with AI. Those who don't want to join don't need to bash it.. There's a reason why 316 people have joined already.
